2037128764168736768.title: Children of the Sun
2037128764168736768.summary: Jay Chou’s 16th studio album opens with 太陽之子 and includes 12 new songs plus the special track 聖誕星. The digital edition was released on March 25, 2026, followed by the physical edition on April 10.
2037128764168736768.dateNote: The date shown is the first digital release; the physical edition followed on April 10, 2026.

1551833317039542272.title: Greatest Works of Art
1551833317039542272.summary: Opening with Intro, this album includes the title track and previously released songs such as 說好不哭 and Mojito. The official introduction identifies Mont-Saint-Michel in France as the location shown on the cover.
1551833317039542272.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

4.title: 說好不哭 with 五月天阿信 Mayday Ashin

1150824720824930304.title: Jay Chou's Bedtime Stories
1150824720824930304.summary: Jay Chou’s 14th studio album contains 10 songs. It opens with 床邊故事 and includes 說走就走 and 告白氣球.
1150824720824930304.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

1151759216223064064.title: Aiyo, Not Bad
1151759216223064064.summary: Opening with 鞋子特大號, this album takes visual cues from Charlie Chaplin’s humor. Its retro cover depicts an encounter between two versions of Jay Chou.
1151759216223064064.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

1151769443223867392.title: Opus 12
1151769443223867392.summary: Released in December 2012, the 12th studio album contains 12 songs, including 紅塵客棧 and 明明就. Its title links the album number, release year and track count.
1151769443223867392.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

1151771029539000320.title: Exclamation Point
1151771029539000320.summary: The 11th studio album was released on November 11, 2011. Opening with its title track, it explores varied subjects through songs including 迷魂曲, Mine Mine, 皮影戲 and 水手怕水.
1151771029539000320.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

1151771608675913728.title: The Era
1151771608675913728.summary: The 10th studio album, released in 2010, uses a vampire-inspired cover. The official introduction emphasizes crossing generations and personal reinvention. Tracks include 超人不會飛 and 說了再見.
1151771608675913728.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

1151772159916511232.title: Capricorn
1151772159916511232.summary: Magic and imagination shape this studio album’s visual world. Its 11 tracks run from 龍戰騎士 to 稻香 and include 給我一首歌的時間 and 花海.
1151772159916511232.dateNote: The date follows JVR’s catalogue (October 14, 2008); some other sources list October 15.

1151772542550282240.title: Jay Chou on the Run
1151772542550282240.summary: Released in 2007, this studio album opens with 牛仔很忙. Its 10 songs include 彩虹, 青花瓷 and 蒲公英的約定.
1151772542550282240.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

1151773902062620672.title: Still Fantasy
1151773902062620672.summary: 夜的第七章 opens the album with a detective story. The official introduction describes a blend of classical music, electronic sounds and rap. Other tracks include 聽媽媽的話, 千里之外 and 菊花台.
1151773902062620672.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

1151774270238625792.title: November's Chopin
1151774270238625792.summary: Named after composer Frédéric Chopin, the sixth studio album was released on November 1. It includes 夜曲, 髮如雪, 飄移 and 一路向北.
1151774270238625792.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

1152151605810958336.title: Common Jasmine Orange
1152151605810958336.summary: Released in 2004, the fifth studio album contains 10 songs in its original edition. Alongside the title track 七里香, it includes 止戰之殤, 外婆 and 擱淺.
1152151605810958336.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

1152152148126076928.title: Yeh Hui Mei
1152152148126076928.summary: Named after Jay Chou’s mother, the fourth studio album opens with 以父之名 and includes 晴天 and 東風破. The official introduction highlights a combination of retro visuals and modern music.
1152152148126076928.dateNote: The date follows JVR’s catalogue (July 29, 2003); some other sources list July 31.

1152152649680949248.title: Eight Dimensions
1152152649680949248.summary: The third studio album connects the musical octave with a world of imagination. It opens with 半獸人 and includes 暗號, 爺爺泡的茶 and 最後的戰役.
1152152649680949248.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

1152155344949088256.title: Fantasy
1152155344949088256.summary: Jay Chou’s second studio album takes its Chinese title from the sound of the English word “Fantasy.” Its imaginative musical world includes 10 songs, among them 愛在西元前, 雙截棍 and 安靜.
1152155344949088256.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

1152155845522493440.title: Jay
1152155845522493440.summary: Jay Chou’s debut studio album was released in 2000, marking his move from behind-the-scenes songwriting to his own recording career. Its 10 tracks include 可愛女人, 星晴, 黑色幽默 and 龍捲風.
1152155845522493440.dateNote: Dates follow the official JVR catalogue and use Taiwan local dates (UTC+08:00).

apple-1858840329.title: 恆星不忘 Forever Forever
apple-1858840329.summary: Released digitally on December 5, 2025, this one-track Mandarin pop-rock single runs 4:47. Jay Chou composed it, with lyrics by Ashin and Huang Ting. Jay Chou, Jerry Yan, Vanness Wu, Vic Chou and Ashin share the vocals. Ashin initiated the collaboration to support the F4 members’ return; its star and eternity imagery reflects more than two decades of friendship. No standalone physical single was released.
apple-1858840329.dateNote: F✦FOREVER released this 4:47 digital single on December 5, 2025. Jay Chou composed it; Ashin and Huang Ting wrote the lyrics. Vocals are by Chou, Jerry Yan, Vanness Wu, Vic Chou and Ashin. The Apple Music Taiwan catalogue lists a one-track digital edition; no simultaneous physical single is documented.

apple-1818534212.title: 即興曲
apple-1818534212.summary: Released on June 6, 2025, this 1:39 solo-piano digital single was improvised and recorded by Jay Chou at Abbey Road Studios in London. The session was first shown in season three of 周遊記. It is an instrumental recording with no vocals or lyrics and has no physical edition.
apple-1818534212.dateNote: JVR Music released this 1:39 piano single on June 6, 2025. Jay Chou improvised it in one take on a Challen piano at Abbey Road Studios in London; the session appears in season three of 周遊記. Apple Music Taiwan lists an instrumental digital single with no physical edition.

apple-1789036121.title: Six Degrees
apple-1789036121.summary: Released on January 10, 2025, this R&B digital single pairs Patrick Brasca and Jay Chou. Brasca composed the song, with lyrics by Father Orson, Brasca and Chou. Simple guitar chords frame a romantic story inspired by six degrees of separation. The single was nominated for Most Popular Digital Single at the 2026 Hito Music Awards.
apple-1789036121.dateNote: JVR Music released this 3:14 R&B studio single on January 10, 2025. Patrick Brasca composed it and sings with Jay Chou; Brasca, Chou and Father Orson wrote the lyrics. The six-degrees-of-separation concept underlies the song. Apple Music Taiwan lists a one-track digital edition.

apple-1754904930.title: 稻香 (Remix搖滾版)
apple-1754904930.summary: Released on July 3, 2024, this digital single reworks the 2008 song 稻香 as a more upbeat rock remix for Sprite, with Jay Chou serving as global brand ambassador. He directed the summer-themed music video. It is a studio remix made for the brand collaboration, with no physical single.
apple-1754904930.dateNote: Released by JVR Music on July 3, 2024, this rock remix of 稻香 was created with Sprite as a global brand campaign song. It is a digital studio remix; Apple Music Taiwan lists one track.

apple-1721878663.title: 聖誕星 (feat. 楊瑞代)
apple-1721878663.summary: Released on December 22, 2023, this roughly three-minute single was written and composed by Jay Chou, arranged by Huang Yu-hsun, and sung with Gary Yang. A crackling fireplace introduces a Christmas song about being single during the holidays. It reunited the pair nearly six years after 等你下課, and Yang also appears in the video. Originally a digital single, it was later included in the 2026 album 太陽之子.
apple-1721878663.dateNote: First released as a digital single on December 22, 2023, this duet with Gary Yang was later added as a special gift for fans to the 13-track 2026 album 太陽之子. This entry refers to the digital single edition listed by Apple Music Taiwan.

apple-1517791422.title: Mojito
apple-1517791422.summary: Released digitally on June 12, 2020, Mojito combines Latin influences with Mandarin pop. Alang Huang wrote the lyrics, Jay Chou composed it, and Huang Yu-hsun arranged it. Named after the Cuban cocktail, the song later appeared on Greatest Works of Art, released July 15, 2022, alongside four other previously released singles. Physical editions include that album’s CD and double vinyl.
apple-1517791422.dateNote: First released digitally on June 12, 2020, then included on Greatest Works of Art on July 15, 2022. There was no standalone physical single; physical releases include that album’s CD and double vinyl editions.

apple-1491480039.title: 我是如此相信(電影《天火》主題曲)
apple-1491480039.summary: Released on December 15, 2019, this 4:26 digital single is the theme song for the film Skyfire, starring Hannah Quinlivan. Vincent Fang wrote the lyrics, Jay Chou composed and sang it, and Huang Yu-hsun arranged it. Its expansive melody and disaster-film setting express faith and mutual support in adversity. It was later included on the 2022 album Greatest Works of Art.
apple-1491480039.dateNote: JVR Music released this Skyfire theme song digitally on December 15, 2019, with lyrics by Vincent Fang and music by Jay Chou. It was later included on the physical editions of Greatest Works of Art in 2022.

1.title: 我是如此相信(電影《天火》主題曲)

apple-1485210180.title: 周杰倫地表最強世界巡迴演唱會
apple-1485210180.summary: Released on November 1, 2019, Jay Chou’s sixth live album documents The Invincible World Tour in a 25-track programme. Songs include 英雄, 雙截棍, 開不了口, 床邊故事, 夜曲+竊愛, 以父之名, 晴天, 稻香, 青花瓷, 告白氣球 and 七里香. DVD and Blu-ray editions use special Space Silver and Cosmic Black metal cases. Apple Music also offers an exclusive Dolby Atmos spatial-audio edition.
apple-1485210180.dateNote: The sixth live album was released on November 1, 2019 and records the September 28–October 1, 2017 Taipei Arena concerts, with 25 tracks. DVD and Blu-ray editions come in special Space Silver and Cosmic Black metal cases, respectively.

19.title: 大笨鐘+暗號+彩虹+龍捲風 (Live)

apple-1480229674.title: 說好不哭
apple-1480229674.summary: Released digitally on September 16, 2019, this piano-led ballad is Jay Chou and Mayday’s Ashin’s first officially released song collaboration. Vincent Fang wrote the lyrics, Chou composed the song, and Huang Yu-hsun arranged it. Its story centers on letting go and wishing someone well. The song later appeared on the physical editions of Greatest Works of Art in 2022.
apple-1480229674.dateNote: Released digitally on September 16, 2019 as a duet with Mayday’s Ashin. There was no standalone physical single; the track later appeared on the CD and double-vinyl editions of Greatest Works of Art in 2022.

apple-1384259101.title: 不愛我就拉倒
apple-1384259101.summary: Released on May 15, 2018, this digital single uses a British-rock style, direct lyrics and Jay Chou’s humor, with a piano interlude as a highlight. Chou and Devon Song wrote the lyrics, Chou composed it, and Sean Chen arranged it. Originally digital-only, it later appeared on the physical editions of Greatest Works of Art in 2022; there was no standalone physical single.
apple-1384259101.dateNote: Released digitally on May 15, 2018 and later collected on the physical editions of Greatest Works of Art in 2022. The single itself had no separate CD or vinyl edition.

apple-1336404440.title: 等你下課 (with 楊瑞代)
apple-1336404440.summary: Released digitally on January 19, 2018, this folk-tinged campus love song was written and composed by Jay Chou, arranged by Huang Yu-hsun, and sung with Gary Yang. The everyday image of waiting after class captures youthful longing. It later appeared on the 2022 album Greatest Works of Art, with no standalone physical single.
apple-1336404440.dateNote: Released digitally on January 19, 2018 in collaboration with Gary Yang. No standalone physical edition was issued; it later appeared on the physical editions of Greatest Works of Art in 2022.

apple-1108410359.title: 魔天倫世界巡迴演唱會
apple-1108410359.summary: Released on May 10, 2016, the fifth live album captures the Opus Jay World Tour in 22 tracks across two discs. The programme includes 驚嘆號, 龍拳, 最後的戰役, 天台, 比較大的大提琴, 哪裡都是你, 一路向北, 不能說的秘密, 明明就, 青花瓷, 彩虹/軌跡 and 陽光宅男. Blu-ray, DVD+2CD and DVD editions use distinctive studded cases in black, orange and white.
apple-1108410359.dateNote: Released on May 10, 2016, the fifth live album captures the September 6–8, 2013 Taipei Arena concerts in 22 tracks across two discs. DVD, DVD+2CD and Blu-ray editions use black, orange and white studded cases, respectively.

5.title: 比較大的大提琴 (with 袁詠琳, 邱凱偉, 楊瑞代 & 宋健彰) (Live)

apple-1095140688.title: 英雄("英雄聯盟"主題曲)
apple-1095140688.summary: Released digitally on March 24, 2016, this League of Legends China brand theme was written, composed and sung by Jay Chou, with an arrangement by Huang Yu-hsun. Heavy rock and hip-hop beats combine with game terminology to create an intense mood. It later appeared on the June 24, 2016 physical CD of Jay Chou’s Bedtime Stories, with no standalone physical single.
apple-1095140688.dateNote: First released digitally on March 24, 2016 as the League of Legends China brand theme, written and composed by Jay Chou. It later appeared on the June 24, 2016 CD of Jay Chou’s Bedtime Stories. No standalone physical single was issued.

apple-1070863333.title: Try (《功夫熊貓3》全球主題曲)
apple-1070863333.summary: Released on January 8, 2016, Try is the global theme song for Kung Fu Panda 3. Jay Chou produced the track and contributed rap; Patrick Brasca composed it and sings with Chou, with lyrics by Vincent Fang and Celeste Syn. Combining Chinese-style rap and pop rock with Mandarin and English lyrics, it was the pair’s first film-theme collaboration. The digital single also appears on the film soundtrack’s double vinyl edition.
apple-1070863333.dateNote: JVR Music released this Kung Fu Panda 3 global theme digitally on January 8, 2016. Produced by Jay Chou and composed by Patrick Brasca, it features both singers and alternating Mandarin and English lyrics. Physical availability includes the soundtrack’s double vinyl edition.

apple-793227801.title: 黃俊郎的黑
apple-793227801.summary: This eight-track instrumental album accompanied Alang Huang’s illustrated book 黃俊郎的黑, published on December 25, 2013. Jay Chou and Gary Yang produced and performed the music, guided by Huang’s writing; Chou composed the featured piano piece 這所有的一切. The album was supplied with the book rather than sold separately.
apple-793227801.dateNote: Published with Alang Huang’s book on December 25, 2013 by Chinese Culture Publishing, this eight-track instrumental CD was produced and performed by Jay Chou and Gary Yang. It was a book supplement and was not sold separately.

apple-667353912.title: 周杰倫「天台」(電影原聲帶)
apple-667353912.summary: Released on July 11, 2013, this 35-track soundtrack accompanies Jay Chou’s second self-directed film, The Rooftop. Chou served as music director; the programme contains 13 songs and 22 instrumental cues, including 波爺, 天台, 打架舞, 快門慢舞, 哪裡都是你, 天台的月光, 美術館, 保齡男孩 and 浪子膏. Sony issued physical editions, including a limited retro collector’s box in Taiwan and a mainland edition from Shanghai Audio & Video Publishing House.
apple-667353912.dateNote: Sony Music released this 35-track soundtrack on July 11, 2013. Produced by JVR Music, it appeared on CD in Taiwan, including a limited retro collector’s box. Shanghai Audio & Video Publishing House issued the mainland edition. The Taiwan limited edition is out of print; Hong Kong editions remain in circulation.

apple-536637791.title: 超時代演唱會
apple-536637791.summary: Released on January 25, 2011, the fourth live album records the Taipei stop of The Era World Tour in 24 tracks across two discs. The set includes 龍戰騎士, 跨時代, 蛇舞, 愛在西元前, 我不配, 威廉古堡, 魔術先生, 黑色幽默, 稻香, 陽光宅男, 說好的幸福呢+淘汰+青花瓷, 東風破 and 雙截棍. Physical editions include a standard DVD and a DVD+2CD collector’s edition; Blu-ray followed on March 25, 2011.
apple-536637791.dateNote: Released on January 25, 2011, the fourth live album records the June 11–13, 2010 Taipei Arena concerts in 24 tracks across two discs. Editions include standard DVD and DVD+2CD; Blu-ray was released separately on March 25, 2011.

11.title: 你是我的OK繃 (with 浪花兄弟) (Live)

apple-1440589158.title: 千山萬水 (2008北京奧運會歌曲)
apple-1440589158.summary: Written for the 2008 Beijing Olympics, this pop-rock song was composed by Jay Chou, with lyrics by Vincent Fang and an arrangement by Chung Hsing-min. It appears on the official Beijing 2008 Olympic Games Songs Album. Chou submitted it by email on the final submission day; it received an Outstanding Song award and was played aboard Shenzhou 7 in space.
apple-1440589158.dateNote: Issued by the Beijing Olympic organizing committee on the official Beijing 2008 Olympic Games Songs Album. The song was played aboard Shenzhou 7 and later preserved by relevant museums. Collectible single-DVD editions also exist alongside the official compilation; the rights are held in permanent national collection.

1.title: 千山萬水 (2008北京奧運會歌曲)

apple-1721457659.title: 不能說的秘密 電影原聲帶
apple-1721457659.summary: Released on August 13, 2007, this 25-track soundtrack accompanies Jay Chou’s directorial debut, Secret. It includes 不能說的秘密, 女孩別為我哭泣, 晴天娃娃 and 情人的眼淚, plus 21 score cues created by Chou and Thai composer Terdsak Janpan, including Opening, 腳踏車, 鬥琴, 路小雨 and Secret. The Taiwan limited edition includes a hardcover commemorative album with 50 film stills.
apple-1721457659.dateNote: Sony Music released this 25-track soundtrack on August 13, 2007. The Taiwan limited edition uses a hardcover photo-album design themed around Xianglun and Xiaoyu’s memories, with 50 stills, the score CD and dialogue. Sony Music China issued the mainland edition; Starsing and other later editions also exist.

apple-536743616.title: 周杰倫2007世界巡迴演唱會
apple-536743616.summary: Released on January 31, 2008, the third live album presents 21 tracks across two discs from the 2007 world tour in Taipei, Shanghai and Hong Kong. Songs include 黃金甲, 無雙, 不能說的秘密, 退後, 最長的電影, 菊花台, 牛仔很忙, 聽媽媽的話, 本草綱目, 千里之外, 夜曲, 髮如雪, 霍元甲 and 雙截棍, plus the Kung Fu Dunk theme 周大俠 as a bonus track. Green 2CD, red DVD and purple 2CD+DVD editions include full-color photo books covering the three cities.
apple-536743616.dateNote: Sony Music Taiwan released the third live album on January 31, 2008, with 21 tracks across two discs from Taipei, Shanghai and Hong Kong. Green 2CD, red DVD and purple 2CD+DVD editions include color photo books and backstage material, plus the Kung Fu Dunk theme 周大俠.

apple-535756564.title: 黃金甲
apple-535756564.summary: Released on December 8, 2006, this two-track EP pairs 黃金甲, the martial-arts-styled theme for Zhang Yimou’s Curse of the Golden Flower, with Jay Chou’s solo-piano version of 菊花台. The CD+DVD collector’s edition includes music videos from Still Fantasy. A deluxe edition limited to 5,000 copies adds film tickets and a 384-page gold-stamped notebook; regional DVD contents differ.
apple-535756564.dateNote: Released on December 8, 2006, this two-track EP contains 黃金甲 and Jay Chou’s piano version of 菊花台. Physical editions include a CD+DVD collector’s edition with videos from Still Fantasy, and a VCD edition; Sony Music China issued the mainland release. Video counts vary between the source descriptions of these editions.

2.title: 菊花台 (杰倫鋼琴演奏版)
aliases: 菊花臺 (杰倫鋼琴演奏版)

apple-536129008.title: 霍元甲
apple-536129008.summary: Released on January 20, 2006, Jay Chou’s third EP contains 霍元甲, the theme for Jet Li’s Fearless, and a Cantonese live version of 獻世 from the 2004 Hong Kong concert. Chou composed the theme and directed its video, incorporating fan dance and three-section-staff imagery. 獻世 was originally written for Jordan Chan in 2003 and became Chou’s first officially released Cantonese song. The CD+DVD edition includes the 霍元甲 video and 12 videos from November’s Chopin.
apple-536129008.dateNote: Alfa Music released the third EP on January 20, 2006. It pairs the Fearless theme with the Cantonese live 獻世 from the 2004 Hong Kong concert. The CD+DVD edition includes the 霍元甲 video, 12 videos from November’s Chopin, and Hong Kong concert highlights. Hong Kong editions are also CD+DVD sets.

apple-535913600.title: 2004 無與倫比演唱會
apple-535913600.summary: Jay Chou’s second live album records the October 2, 2004 Taipei Municipal Stadium concert in 25 tracks across two discs. The set includes 以父之名, 止戰之殤, 晴天, 你聽得到, 園遊會, 將軍, 我的地盤, 擱淺, 藉口, 七里香, 外婆, 東風破 and 軌跡, plus several medleys. Warner issued the original physical editions on January 21, 2005 as 2CD+DVD, DVD and VCD; Sony BMG later reissued it.
apple-535913600.dateNote: The second live album captures the October 2, 2004 Taipei Municipal Stadium concert in 25 tracks across two discs. Warner’s original January 21, 2005 editions—2CD+DVD, DVD and VCD—are discontinued. Sony BMG later reissued it.

11.title: 星晴 + 回到過去 + 最後的戰役 + 愛我別走 (Live)

17.title: 雙刀 + 雙截棍 + 龍拳 (Live)

apple-536108118.title: 尋找周杰倫
apple-536108118.summary: Released in November 2003, Jay Chou’s second EP accompanies the film Hidden Track. Its four tracks are the British-rock-influenced ballad 軌跡, the lighter 斷了的弦, and karaoke versions of both. Sony issued the original edition; later CD+DVD reissues add 11 music videos from 葉惠美.
apple-536108118.dateNote: Released in November 2003, the four-track EP contains 軌跡, 斷了的弦 and their karaoke versions. Alfa Music produced the original edition, Sony issued it, and Sony Music China handled the mainland release. Later JVR/Sony CD+DVD reissues add 11 videos from 葉惠美.

apple-536686684.title: The One 周杰倫演唱會
apple-536686684.summary: Jay Chou’s first live album captures the 2002 THE ONE concert in Taipei in 20 tracks across two discs. Songs include Opening 雙截棍, 忍者, 爺爺泡的茶, 暗號, 愛在西元前, 半島鐵盒, 回到過去, 鬥牛, 分裂, 安靜, 黑色幽默, 找自己, 龍捲風, 星晴, 龍拳, 上海一九四三, 最後的戰役, 簡單愛 and 開不了口. Alfa Music issued formats including 2CD+DVD, with 10 videos from 八度空間, and 2DVD.
apple-536686684.dateNote: This recording of the 2002 THE ONE Taipei concert contains 20 tracks across two discs. Alfa Music issued several formats, including a long-box 2CD+DVD, 2DVD and VCD. JVR-era DVD reissues also exist, including a two-DVD edition with an obi strip.

17.title: 你怎麼連話都說不清楚 (Live)

apple-536110584.title: 范特西Plus
apple-536110584.summary: Jay Chou’s first EP contains three live versions of songs he wrote for other artists: 蝸牛, originally sung by Valen Hsu; 你比從前快樂, originally sung by Jacky Wu; and 世界末日, originally sung by S.B.D.W. BMG issued a limited deluxe CD+VCD edition, with 13 complete music videos and a Jay-branded scarf available in different colors.
apple-536110584.dateNote: Released in December 2001, Jay Chou’s first EP features three live performances of songs written for other artists: 蝸牛, 你比從前快樂 and 世界末日. BMG issued a limited deluxe CD+VCD edition with 13 full music videos and a Jay-branded scarf.
